_about: Shared mapping fixture for the customer-shaped bug report. Each case is one mobile_report_result call (args, plus the run's crash records where a case needs them) and the bug text the product stores for it: bug is null when no bug is filed. bug.steps is the bug's steps text (the code investigation, or the summary); bug.repro_steps is the agent's own step list as the product stores it beside that text and shows as the reproduction steps (an empty list when the call carried none). product_only fields are checked by the product's test alone. The same bytes are committed in the benchmark and in the product repository and tested in both. sha256 is the SHA-256 of this file's UTF-8 text with the sha256 line removed; each test also pins it. To change a case, edit both copies, recompute the hash and update the pin in both tests.
